identity.name: BBC News
identity.description: The news division of the UK public broadcaster, providing global reporting, live coverage and analysis in English and many other languages.

ownership.ownershipNotes: A public-service broadcaster funded primarily by the licence fee and commercial activities, governed by a royal charter. Editorial independence is formally protected but contested in UK political debate.

editorialOrientation.evidence: Royal charter and editorial guidelines require independence; coverage includes critical reporting on UK governments of different parties.
editorialOrientation.source: Ownership and self-description via Official about page; secondary references; feed-level sample

politicalLeaning.evidence: MBFC rates Least Biased and Mostly Factual; UK coverage is broad and institutionally centrist, with critics alleging a metropolitan liberal outlook.

economicPerspective.evidence: Economic coverage is explanatory and range-bound, without a consistent partisan economic programme.

internationalAlignment.evidence: Frames security and foreign policy from a UK/European perspective and gives substantial space to NATO and Western alliance positions, alongside global voices.
internationalAlignment.source: Ownership, editorial positioning and regional coverage sample

reliability.evidence: MBFC rates factual reporting Mostly Factual and credibility High; long-established corrections and editorial standards.

externalRatings.notes: MBFC: Least Biased; factual reporting Mostly Factual; credibility High (retrieved 2026-10-25).

intelligence.knownPerspective: Global public-broadcaster voice. Combines fast breaking-news capacity with explanatory reporting, usually framed through UK/European institutional perspectives and liberal-democratic norms.

selectionRationale: A high-reliability global baseline with strong breaking-news and explanatory capacity, already proven in the ingestion pipeline.

research.researchNotes: Existing production mapping treats BBC as Commercial Publisher; the profile records Public Service ownership. Mapping left unchanged for compatibility and flagged for schema review. Research is feed-level only; full article sampling and peer review remain outstanding.
